title.zh: 消息称Amodei、Altman和Hassabis在G7峰会上呼吁美国主导AI规则合作
title.en: Sources: Amodei, Altman, and Hassabis called for US-led collaboration on AI rules at the G7 summit; Macron and Modi raised concerns over the US block on Mythos

summary.zh: 马克龙和莫迪对美国封锁Mythos表示担忧。

title.zh: 消息称特朗普政府官员讨论如何构建政府在AI公司中的股权结构
title.en: Sources: Trump officials discussed how to structure government equity stakes in AI companies, with Commerce Secretary Lutnick preferring a sovereign wealth fund

summary.zh: 商务部长Lutnick倾向于设立主权财富基金。

title.zh: Allbirds更名为Smartbird，转型为AI基础设施公司
title.en: Shoe company Allbirds changes its name to Smartbird as it pivots to an AI infrastructure company and names ex-AWS exec Nadia Carlsten as CEO; BIRD jumps 39%

summary.zh: 公司任命前AWS高管Nadia Carlsten为CEO，股价上涨39%。

title.zh: OpenAI首席战略官向员工表示已强烈建议美国政府吸引全球顶尖AI人才
title.en: OpenAI's Chief Strategy Officer messaged staff that OpenAI “strongly” told the US government that building AI “requires the best talent from around the world”

title.zh: 研究表明德国开发的AI医疗工具Mira和Google的Amie在诊断和治疗决策上匹敌或超越医生
title.en: Studies: Mira, an AI medical tool developed by researchers in Germany, and Google's Amie matched or surpassed doctors on diagnostic and treatment decisions

title.zh: 消息称Jeff Bezos投资英国CuspAI，专注生成式AI在材料科学领域的应用
title.en: Sources: Jeff Bezos is investing in Cambridge, UK-based CuspAI, which applies generative AI to material sciences, as part of a $400M round at a $2.6B valuation

summary.zh: CuspAI完成4亿美元融资，估值达26亿美元。

title.zh: 美国政府通过CHIPS法案向SandboxAQ提供5亿美元，用于开发半导体制造的新化学品和材料
title.en: The US government awards $500M under the CHIPS Act to SandboxAQ to use AI models to develop new chemicals and materials for domestic semiconductor manufacturing

title.zh: 爱沙尼亚计划为AI代理分配个人ID号以实现有限、可控和可审计的授权
title.en: Estonia says it will assign personal ID numbers to AI agents to give them “limited, controllable, and auditable authorizations” as they take actions for humans

title.zh: 消息称美国推迟将DeepSeek、CXMT等100多家公司列入实体清单
title.en: Sources: the US has held off adding DeepSeek, CXMT, and 100+ other flagged companies to its Entity List, last updated in October, the longest gap in 10+ years

summary.zh: 这是10多年来更新间隔最长的一次。

title.zh: 消息称Meta支持KOSA法案，因其包含预防州AI法律的条款
title.en: Sources: Meta moved to support KOSA after it was packaged with language preempting state AI laws and a bill that would require app stores to verify users' ages

summary.zh: 法案还要求应用商店验证用户年龄。

title.zh: 哈萨克斯坦与Firebird签署协议，计划投资100亿美元建设数据中心谷
title.en: Kazakhstan signs accords with Firebird on Nvidia-related computing projects that could bring up to $10B in investment, as it seeks to build a Data Center Valley

title.zh: 前阿里巴巴Qwen模型负责人林俊阳创立的新AI实验室融资数亿美元，估值约20亿美元
title.en: Sources: a new AI lab founded by Junyang Lin, a former lead of Alibaba's Qwen models, has raised several hundred million dollars at a ~$2B post-money valuation

title.zh: Odyssey初创公司融资3.1亿美元，估值14.5亿美元，将使用AWS和Trainium芯片
title.en: World models startup Odyssey raised $310M from Amazon and others at a $1.45B valuation and will use AWS as its preferred cloud partner, deploying Trainium chips

title.zh: Twenty公司利用AI帮助美军黑客渗透网络，完成1亿美元B轮融资，估值10亿美元
title.en: Twenty, which uses AI to help US military hackers penetrate adversary computer networks, raised a $100M Series B led by Accel at a $1B valuation

title.zh: XDOF公司专注于机器人训练数据管道和标注系统，完成7000万美元融资
title.en: XDOF, which is building data pipelines, collection tools, and annotation systems for robot training data, emerges from stealth with $70M

title.zh: Convey公司开发AI助手自动化工作流，完成由a16z领投的3800万美元A轮融资
title.en: Convey, which is building AI “teammates” to automate workflows for clients like NBCUniversal, Samsara, and TelevisaUnivision, raised a $38M Series A led by a16z

title.zh: 巴黎初创公司Comand AI开发军事指挥控制软件，完成3200万欧元A轮融资
title.en: Paris-based Comand AI, which is developing AI-based command-and-control software for military operations, raised a €32M Series A led by Blossom Capital

title.zh: Epic宣布Unreal Engine 6计划2027年推出，将整合UE5和Fortnite编辑器，并支持Claude和Gemini
title.en: Epic says Unreal Engine 6, planned for early access in late 2027, will unify UE5 and Unreal Editor for Fortnite, add integrations with Claude and Gemini, more

title.zh: Uber计划2027年将其高端机器人出租车服务扩展至休斯顿，与Lucid和Nuro合作
title.en: Uber says it will expand its premium robotaxi service from San Francisco to Houston by mid-2027, in partnership with EV maker Lucid and AV startup Nuro

title.zh: 三星因AI需求增加，接到比亚迪、谷歌、AMD、特斯拉等公司更多先进芯片生产订单
title.en: Sources: Samsung is seeing a rise in advanced chip production requests from BYD, Google, AMD, Tesla, and other companies as AI demand strains TSMC's capacity

title.zh: Databricks年化收入同比增长80%以上，达到69亿美元
title.en: Databricks says its annualized revenue rose 80%+ YoY to $6.9B, up from $5.4B in Q4; CEO Ali Ghodsi says AI agent usage is increasing costs and lowering margins

summary.zh: Databricks CEO Ali Ghodsi表示，AI代理的使用正在增加成本并降低利润率。

title.zh: Frontier承诺追加9.15亿美元购买碳移除信用额度
title.en: Frontier, a group including Stripe, Google, Salesforce, and newly joined Anthropic, commits $915M to buy carbon-removal credits, on top of $1B already pledged

summary.zh: 包括Stripe、Google、Salesforce和Anthropic在内的Frontier集团承诺追加9.15亿美元购买碳移除信用额度，总承诺金额已达10亿美元。

title.zh: Z.ai发布GLM-5.2，支持百万Token上下文窗口
title.en: GLM-5.2 (6 minute read)

summary.zh: GLM-5.2专注于编码任务，提供新的推理控制和长时间跨度代码支持，并计划开放API和MIT许可的权重。
summary.en: Z.ai launched GLM-5.2 with a 1 million-token context window, new reasoning controls, and support for long-horizon coding tasks across entire codebases. The company made the model available immediately to Coding Plan users and plans to release API access, chatbot support, technical details, and MIT-licensed open weights the following week. Z.ai positions GLM-5.2 as a coding-first upgrade focused on agentic software engineering, though it did not publish benchmark results at launch.

title.zh: Android 17扩展AI代理集成功能
title.en: Android 17 Expands AI Agent Integration (8 minute read)

summary.zh: Android 17引入了AppFunctions和Android MCP，支持设备上的AI代理发现和执行工具，推动平台向智能系统转型。
summary.en: Android 17 introduced new AI-focused capabilities centered on AppFunctions and Android MCP, enabling apps to expose orchestratable tools that on-device agents can discover and execute. Google positioned the release as part of a broader shift toward an “intelligence system” with deeper AI integration across the platform.

title.zh: Qwen推出语言驱动的机器人世界模型
title.en: Qwen's Embodied World Modeling (28 minute read)

summary.zh: Qwen-RobotWorld是一种语言驱动的视频世界模型，统一了机器人、导航、驾驶等领域的自然语言操作接口。
summary.en: Qwen-RobotWorld is a language-conditioned video world model that uses natural language as a unified action interface across robotics, navigation, driving, and other embodied domains.

title.zh: Cursor Origin：面向AI代理的GitHub替代品
title.en: Cursor Origin (1 minute read)

summary.zh: Cursor Origin是一个Git兼容的代码托管平台，专为AI代理的并行开发和管理任务设计。
summary.en: Cursor Origin is an attempt at an agent-native GitHub competitor. The Git-compatible forge is built around the assumption that lots of AI agents will be cloning, branching, committing, rebasing, reviewing, and fixing failures in parallel. Cursor is trying to own the whole AI software factory. GitHub was built for human-scale development, but Origin was built for agent-scale.

title.zh: OpenAI为Codex推出浏览器CDP支持
title.en: OpenAI released CDP support for browser use on Codex (2 minute read)

summary.zh: Codex现支持Chrome DevTools协议，可实时分析JavaScript性能并修改网站，标志着OpenAI向AI驱动的网络迈进。
summary.en: OpenAI's Codex now supports Chrome DevTools Protocol, enabling live browser access to profile JavaScript performance and modify websites in real time. This early-stage feature, available via opt-in settings but excluded from the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, faces performance issues and requires careful prompting. Recent OpenAI moves, such as acquiring Ona, aim to create persistent cloud environments, highlighting a push toward an AI-driven web.

title.zh: NVIDIA Blackwell在MLPerf Training 6.0中表现卓越
title.en: Fastest, Largest, Strongest: NVIDIA Blackwell Sweeps MLPerf Training 6.0 (6 minute read)

summary.zh: NVIDIA Blackwell平台以最快训练时间和最大规模训练主导MLPerf Training 6.0基准测试，展示了其在大规模AI环境中的可靠性和性能。
summary.en: NVIDIA's Blackwell platform dominated MLPerf Training 6.0 benchmarks, achieving the fastest training times and the largest-scale training with 8,192 GPUs. Blackwell's NVLink and NVFP4 innovations enhance performance by efficiently routing MoE models and enabling rapid, large-scale training. Reliability features like the Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability Engine and NVIDIA Resiliency Extension ensure minimal downtime and faster recovery in large-scale AI environments.

title.zh: 高通发布面向AI设备的Snapdragon Reality Elite平台
title.en: Qualcomm wants to be the chip inside whatever replaces your smartphone, and it just announced two products toward that end (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 高通推出Snapdragon Reality Elite平台和AI-Ready工具包，旨在成为智能手机后时代AI设备的核心芯片。
summary.en: Qualcomm is working on over 40 different AI wearable devices. It has announced a platform called Snapdragon Reality Elite for mixed-reality glass and the Scalable Turnkey AI-Ready toolkit, a combination of hardware models and a software stack for AI devices. The company is aiming to position itself as the foundational silicon layer for whatever is coming after the smartphone. It is experimenting with a range of potential form factors that can work with AI technologies.

title.zh: OpenAI为ChatGPT语音模式推出GPT-Bidi-1升级
title.en: OpenAI prepares major ChatGPT voice upgrade with GPT-Bidi-1 (2 minute read)

summary.zh: GPT-Bidi-1是一种双向音频模型，支持同时听和说，并能在句中调整响应。
summary.en: GPT-Bidi-1 is a bidirectional audio model for ChatGPT's voice mode designed to listen and speak at once, absorb interruptions, and adjust mid-sentence.

title.zh: 微软测试Phi Silica用于Windows AI，运行于Nvidia GPU
title.en: Microsoft Tests Phi Silica for Windows AI on Nvidia GPUs (6 minute read)

summary.zh: 微软的Phi Silica小型语言模型专为在Windows Copilot+ PC的神经处理单元上本地运行而设计。
summary.en: Microsoft's Phi Silica small language models are explicitly engineered to run locally on the Neural Processing Units of Windows Copilot+ PCs.
